title: Judging the Judges: Evaluating Alignment and Vulnerabilities in LLMs-as-Judges
authors_zh: Aman Singh Thakur, Kartik Choudhary, Venkat Srinik Ramayapally, Sankaran Vaidyanathan, Dieuwke Hupkes
paper_type_zh: 污染、验证器、奖励或评测可靠性审计
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理数据与自动评测可靠性的研究者。
one_line: Measures how LLM judges agree with humans and how prompting and references destabilize their verdicts.
量化 LLM 评审与人工的一致性，并揭示提示词、参考答案顺序和宽松偏差造成的失稳。
why: It demonstrates that a judge's ranking ability can conceal poorly calibrated human-aligned decisions.
inclusion_reason: Audits LLM-judge agreement with humans and exposes leniency, prompt and reference-order failure modes.

title: Problem
问题
html: High agreement with another automated judge can hide disagreement with people. This paper isolates the problem on short TriviaQA answers, where human agreement is deliberately high, and asks how well common LLM judges reproduce human correctness decisions and rankings.
与另一自动评审高度一致，并不等于与人一致。论文在人工一致性被刻意做得很高的短 TriviaQA 答案上，检验常见 LLM 评审能否复现人工正确性判决与系统排序。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The authors collect human correctness labels for model answers and score the same answers with 11 LLM judges plus lexical baselines. They evaluate percentage agreement, Scott's pi and system-ranking correlation, then perturb prompt detail and reference-answer order to expose whether apparent alignment is calibration, leniency or prompt sensitivity.
作者为模型回答收集人工正确性标注，并让 11 个 LLM 评审和词法基线判定同一回答；以一致率、Scott's pi 与系统排序相关性评估，再扰动提示词详略和参考答案顺序，区分表面一致、宽松偏差与提示敏感性。

title: Method
方法
html: From 400 TriviaQA validation questions, nine examinee models produce answers. Thirteen judges receive the question, reference and answer and return correct/incorrect; five demonstrations are used. Three humans majority-label 1,200 answers (then one annotator labels the remainder). The study compares judge labels and model rankings to humans, analyzes 900 errors, and varies prompt length and reference order.
从 400 个 TriviaQA 验证问题中，由九个答题模型生成回答。13 个评审看到问题、参考答案和回答，以五个示例输出对错；三名人工对 1,200 条做多数标注，其余由单人标注。研究比较评审标签和模型排序与人工的一致性，分析 900 个错误，并改变提示长度和参考顺序。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Human agreement is 98.52% (Scott's pi 96.2). Only GPT-4 Turbo, Llama-3-70B and Llama-3.1-70B reach pi in the high 80s, still roughly eight points below humans; headline percentage agreement can conceal five-point evaluation-score errors. “contains” has rank correlation 0.99 and GPT-4/Mistral 0.98, showing ranking and calibrated instance labels differ.
人工一致率为 98.52%，Scott's pi 为 96.2。仅 GPT-4 Turbo、Llama-3-70B、Llama-3.1-70B 的 pi 达到 80 多，仍比人工低约 8 点；高一致率可掩盖 5 点的评测分数误差。contains 的排序相关性 0.99，GPT-4/Mistral 为 0.98，说明排序与校准到单条判决不同。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The contribution is a deliberately low-ambiguity human-alignment test, not another benchmark win. By separating chance-corrected agreement from ranking and testing prompt/reference perturbations, it shows that strong-looking LLM judges can be systematically lenient or brittle even when the task itself admits a clear human verdict.
贡献不是又一个基准胜负，而是在低歧义场景中直接测量人机对齐。它把机会校正的一致性与排序分开，并测试提示/参考扰动，因此能发现即使任务本身有清楚人工答案，强评审仍可能系统性宽松或脆弱。

title: Limitations
局限
html: TriviaQA is intentionally short and high-agreement, so the findings do not establish behavior on open-ended or rubric-based evaluation. Only 400 questions are assessed and the prompt/model set is bounded. The results diagnose association with human labels, not robustness to adversarial answers, contamination, or a causal source of any model bias.
TriviaQA 被刻意限制为短回答、高人工一致性，因此结果不能外推到开放式或复杂 rubric 评测。只评估了 400 题，提示与模型集合也有限；它诊断的是与人工标签的关联，不检验对抗回答、污染，也未给出偏差的因果来源。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Before relying on an LLM judge, label a small human audit set and report Scott's pi as well as ranking correlation. Stratify false positives for leniency, underspecification and answer-format failures, then vary prompt verbosity and reference ordering. Treat a judge as a measurement instrument that needs calibration, not as a substitute for ground truth.
使用 LLM 评审前，应人工标注小型审计集，同时报告 Scott's pi 与排序相关性；按宽松、信息不足和答案格式错误分层假阳性，再改变提示详略与参考顺序。评审应被当作需要校准的测量仪器，而不是事实真值的替代品。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The error study finds underspecified answers particularly hard: Llama-3-70B recalls only 23.3% while GPT-4 reaches 33.9%. Smaller judges are more prompt- and reference-order-sensitive; several show strong positive-answer leniency. Keep lexical baselines: their excellent ranking is evidence that ranking can mask poor verdict calibration.
错误分析显示“信息不足”的回答最难判：Llama-3-70B 的召回仅 23.3%，GPT-4 为 33.9%。小模型对提示和参考顺序更敏感，多个评审对正面回答明显宽松。应保留词法基线：其极佳排序提醒我们，排序好可掩盖单条判决的校准差。
